description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Boolean, which represents a boolean value in the Zend XML-RPC value handling framework, extending the Scalar class and providing methods to set and retrieve boolean values as integers and booleans.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Boolean
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a boolean value in the XML-RPC framework, providing constructor and accessor methods to handle boolean data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the boolean value object, setting the internal type and storing the boolean as an integer (0 or 1).

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the stored value as a boolean.
